jsonld_raw.name: (220 G) MULLED SPICES SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Mulled spices | A fruity and spicy opening reminiscent of Polish winters and their traditional drinks. The heart recreates mulled wine with cinnamon, leather, and tobacco, intense and cozy.
Gourmand base of vanilla, tonka, and woods.

NOTES
Top notes: orange, cranberry, clove, apple
Heart notes: cinnamon, leather, tobacco, mulled wine
Base notes: cedarwood, vanilla, gourmand, tonka bean
